rules_satisfied: No unchecked indexing - replaced parts[1] with split_once
No lossy as conversions - replaced with try_from
Checked arithmetic - checked_add for totals, checked_div for average
Function signature matches test contract - returns Result<Summary, SummaryError>
render_summary function added as required by tests
Functional core pattern - pure summarize_metrics, separate render_summary
cargo fmt and cargo fmt --check clean
residual_risk: count_u32 uses unwrap_or(u32::MAX) as defensive fallback for usize->u32 narrowing; in practice count is bounded by max_rows passed by caller, so u32::MAX would only appear if the caller passes a usize > u32::MAX which violates the API contract. count as u64 replaced with u64::try_from(count) which is a widening cast always safe on all platforms.
